lines.text: Jehu son of Hanani rebuked Jehoshaphat for helping the wicked, yet noted he had removed the Asherah poles.
Jehoshaphat went out from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned the people back to the LORD.
Jehoshaphat appointed judges in each fortified city of Judah and said they judged for the king, not man.
In Jerusalem he appointed Levites, priests, and family heads to judge and to warn people against incurring guilt.
Jehoshaphat put Zebadiah the chief priest over the LORD's matters and Amariah the ruler over the king's matters.

wrong_details.wrong: Zebadiah the chief priest over the LORD's matters

wrong_details.true: Zebadiah, the ruler of the house of Judah, over all that pertains to the king
